question: Does receipt-authorized Crop(224)->Normalize remove full-resolution pointwise work in a real cedar/PyTorch workload while preserving exact preprocessing and MobileNetV3-small training semantics?

pipeline.manual_safe_oracle: A non-inplace per-pixel channel affine Normalize commutes with a no-padding RandomCrop that only selects spatial indices, provided H,W >= 224. RandomCrop consumes one RNG draw sequence in either order because Normalize consumes none. The trailing Identity is inert; it is retained because P5R freezes a workload-specific, cedar-compatible profile for this three-mapper pipeline. The manual arm is a semantic oracle, not a performance comparator.

profile_phase.purpose: Predeclared descriptive scaling profile. This phase must pass all semantic checks before S3 confirmation is run.

confirm_phase.purpose: Confirmatory high-resolution cell, executed in a separate fresh Python process after the profile output is frozen.

measurement.paired_order: AB/BA alternating by pair index; each block includes fresh cedar preprocessing and one deterministic MobileNetV3-small training pass
measurement.descriptive_ci: Within-run paired delta bootstrap: 2000 resamples, fixed seed 20260807, 95% percentile interval. This is descriptive only.
measurement.confirmatory_gate_ci: Across two S3 runs: 10000-resample paired-log-ratio bootstrap; its 95% upper endpoint must be below log(0.95).

semantic_endpoints: exact output tensors, shapes, and exception behavior
MobileNetV3-small loss sequence, logits, gradients, and final model state
storage_endpoint: For each output tensor report logical bytes and retained backing-storage bytes; a crop view retaining a full-resolution normalized backing tensor is not treated as a memory win.
benefit_go_rule: For each independent S3 run, paired median guarded/baseline end-to-end ratio must be below 0.95. Across both independent runs, a 10000-resample paired bootstrap of mean log(guarded/baseline) must have 95% CI upper endpoint below log(0.95). All semantic checks must pass.
pass_rule: Every semantic check must pass. Timing is descriptive and cannot compensate for a semantic failure.
claim_boundary: Real JPEG content from cedar's test fixture is decoded and deterministically resized before timing, yielding a shape-faithful resident-tensor proxy; the known relation-algebra-supported pair remains internal. This is not independent evaluation, a benchmark claim, dataset-I/O measurement, or evidence of a general training-speed benefit.
